{{recipe}}
==Ingredients==
*5 corn/wheat [[Cookbook:Tortilla|tortillas]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Smoked Salmon|smoked salmon]] [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]] spread

==Procedure==
#In a small bowl, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] together eggs, milk, lemon juice, and pepper.
#In [[Cookbook:Sauté pan|sauté pan]] over medium heat, add oil to coat the pan, add egg mixture to scramble.
#Toast the tortillas in a cast iron [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium heat. Spread cream spread in a circle with 2 inches from the edge of tortilla. Add eggs.
#Wrap and enjoy.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* [[Cookbook:Whole Wheat Flour|Whole-wheat]] tortillas add more fiber/complex carbs!
* Spring mix lettuce can be added to liven it up a bit.
